intro:
In 2026, 1,265 Australians found out their "2026" BYD had actually been built in 2025. BYD's first offer was $1,100 – owners pushed back and got $3,500, plus refunds or replacements. A Victorian buyer won a full refund in the Supreme Court over a rusty car, the dealers' own review admits the system is failing, and new penalties are coming. Here are the real 2026 cases, your rights under the Australian Consumer Law, and the exact steps to take if your new car is a lemon.

This video is general information, not legal advice.
